speaker: CALLER
text: Namaste, main local police station se bol raha hoon, passport verification ke liye.

speaker: CALLER
text: Aap ghar par kab milenge? Constable aayega document verification ke liye, aapka Aadhaar card aur rent agreement chahiye hoga.

speaker: CALLER
text: Theek hai, kal gyarah baje aa jayenge. Aap ghar walon ko bata dijiyega. Agar koi confusion ho to aap station aa kar mil sakte hain, ya thane ke landline par call kar sakte hain.

speaker: CALLER
text: Aur sir, hum kabhi phone par paise ya OTP nahi maangte. Agar koi aisa kare to turant complaint kijiye.
